```yaml
name: Sync AI connector docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout main repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get Octavia token
        id: octavia
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_DOMAIN }}
          audience: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_AUDIENCE }}
          scope: repo
          policy: ${{ secrets.OCTAVIA_POLICY }}

      - name: Checkout airbyte-ai-connectors repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-ai-connectors
          ref: main
          path: airbyte-ai-connectors
          token: ${{ steps.octavia.outputs.token }}

      - name: Sync connector docs
        run: |
          DEST_DIR=docs/ai-agents/connectors
          rm -rf "$DEST_DIR"
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
          for dir in airbyte-ai-connectors/*/; do
            if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
              find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" -exec cp {} "$DEST_DIR" \;
            fi
          done

      - name: Create PR
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ steps.octavia.outputs.token }}
          commit-message: Sync AI connector docs
          title: Sync AI connector docs
          body: |
            This PR syncs AI connector documentation from the airbyte-ai-connectors repository.
          branch: sync-ai-connector-docs
          base: main
          delete-branch: true
          labels: documentation,auto-merge
```
